item.title: Israeli diplomat says Israel must prepare for less US support
item.description: Israeli Consul General in New York Ofir Akunis warned that shifting US political attitudes pose a long-term challenge to the bilateral relationship.

item.title: Virginia Democrat's past support for far-left prosecutors surfaces
item.description: Shannon Taylor's record as Henrico County prosecutor conflicts with her tough-on-crime campaign image in the race for Virginia's 1st district.

item.title: Dick Morris: 7 DSA wins could reshape Democratic caucus
item.description: A group of Democratic Socialists of America-backed candidates could gain decisive influence in a narrow Democratic majority in the next Congress.

item.title: Hawaii voters head to polls; governor leads, progressive challenges congressman
item.description: In Hawaii's 1st District primary, Rep. Ed Case faces Jarrett Keohokalole, who opposes Trump tariffs and ICE enforcement.
